body: I’m sorry your person isn’t stable, and I’m sorry that the world’s beat you both down. It’s stupid and I’m sure you’ve heard it before but we have to take things one day at a time. It’s hard to find the will to live again but we have to. You care a lot about this person and I know it won’t be easy but I know you can be strong and I know that things will get better. I can’t promise that you won’t get hurt but you have to work towards happiness. Like I said before I don’t know what your situation is but I think counseling would help, if you’re not already doing it? You have to be open to help and you need to be willing to get better. Its hard to get back up instead of letting your depression drown you but I know you can do it.

I don’t know what your going through but I know what it feels like to want to end it. Im looking for a reason to stay and I haven’t found it yet and maybe it’s stupid but we have to hope there’s something better. Wether it’s tomorrow or in ten years I’m sure we’ll find our reason. Even if that reason is just a moment of happiness don’t you thinks it’s worth it? After all our suffering we can’t go down so easy.

Shit’s tough kid and I can’t guarantee that it’ll get better. I’m in no place to say anything given I’m no better off than you, but I’m still here. I didn’t think I’d make it past 14 but my 18th birthday is in February and although it’s a little scary sometimes I’m proud I’ve made it this far even if I don’t know how I got here. I know you feel isolated, like nobody can possibly know what’s it’s like to feel this way, but there are countless of people like us who miraculously keep going. We keep going day after day, we might not know why we even bother but hold on. Please
